item.title: Jason Sourasis secures last-minute deal to save Western United
item.description: A last-minute agreement has spared A-League club Western United from liquidation, giving operator and major shareholder Jason Sourasis a chance to revive the struggling side. The reprieve came after the Australian Taxation Office accepted a payment plan for a $15.5 million tax debt. item.title: Sixteen killed in father-and-son terror attack at Bondi Beach…
item.description: Sixteen people, including a gunman, are dead following what police have declared a terrorist attack on a Jewish festival at Sydney’s Bondi Beach, as leaders condemned the violence as an act of “pure evil” antisemitism. item.title: Top of the class: Greek Australian students claim VCE dux…
item.description: Greek Australian students have once again demonstrated academic excellence, with a remarkable cohort named duxes across Victorian schools following the release of the 2025 VCE results. Leading the list is Georgios Pirpiris, who achieved a perfect ATAR of 99.95 to become dux of Melbourne Grammar School, placing him among the top students in the state. item.title: Greek Australian leaders voice solidarity with Jewish…
item.description: In the aftermath of the Bondi Beach shooting during a Hanukkah gathering, Greek Australian community leaders have publicly expressed their solidarity with the Jewish Australian community and have unequivocally condemned the attack. The incident, which occurred during a religious celebration, has reverberated across Australia’s multicultural communities, prompting renewed calls for unity, vigilance, and collective action […] The post Greek Australian leaders voice solidarity with Jewish community

item.title: Greek Communities of Melbourne and NSW stand with Jewish…
item.description: The Greek Community of Melbourne (GCM) and the Greek Orthodox Community of New South Wales (GOCNSW) have expressed deep sorrow and condemnation following the deadly attack at Bondi Beach on Sunday, offering condolences to the Jewish community and calling for unity, calm and respect in the wake of the tragedy.
